title: ERiK-Methodological Report V
summary: The ERiK-Methodological Report V is the fifth in a series of methodological reports related to the 'Entwicklung von Rahmenbedingungen in der Kindertagesbetreuung - indikatorengestützte Qualitätsbeobachtung (ERiK)' study. The report contains all background information on the methodology of the ERiK-Surveys 2024.
